name: Whores of Thrones: Season 1
source: Choose the fate of your favourite characters and others while fulfilling your fantasies in this adult themed point & click saga of lust, perversion, ambition, deception, cruelty and even more lust and perversion as the calm before the storm slowly clouds the seven Kingdoms.​
translation: 在这款以成人为主题的点击式欲望传奇中，满足你的幻想，选择最喜欢的角色和其他人的命运。七大王国表面平静，实则正被欲望、堕落、野心、欺骗、残酷，以及更多欲望与堕落逐渐笼罩。
